title: Add image2gpt to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [image2gpt](https://image2gpt.vercel.app) to image
- Generates images with openai/gpt-image-2. Visitors sign in with their own Pollinations account via OAuth (BYOP) and spend their own Pollen, so the app itself pays nothing. Includes a prompt box, three

Fixes #15477

gist.headline: A new image in the garden
gist.blurb: image2gpt joins the app garden. Bring a prompt and your own Pollinations account; the images are yours, and so is the Pollen tab.
gist.summary: Added image2gpt to the app directory, where visitors can generate images with openai/gpt-image-2 after signing in through Pollinations OAuth.
gist.impact: Visitors can discover image2gpt, enter a prompt, and use their own Pollen to generate images.
gist.visual_concept: Depict image2gpt as a friendly image-making station in a garden: a prompt box feeds a small framed picture, with an OAuth sign-in doorway and a Pollen token nearby. Polli helps tend the station; no separate app mascot is indicated.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli wears a tiny painter's beret and taps a prompt into a retro image-making station, where a framed picture blooms beside a prominent lime green (#ecf874) flower pot. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized or dominating, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a soft lime green (#ecf874) and warm cream background, chunky sprites, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
